_instructions: Merge the object at 'trips.settlement.cashHandover' below into the EXISTING frontend/src/i18n/locales/en/logistics.json, under the existing 'trips.settlement' object (a sibling of 'settlement', 'driver', 'actions', 'carrier', 'status', 'summary'). This file is NOT a drop-in replacement for logistics.json — it exists only to state the exact keys/values to add, without reproducing that large, shared, 2500+-key file. Do not add the '_instructions' key itself.

cashHandover.title: Treasury Cash Handover
cashHandover.description: Count the physical cash received from the driver and confirm the handover. This posts to the company's Treasury cash account.
cashHandover.confirmFailed: The handover could not be confirmed. Check the amount, the selected account, and your permissions, then try again.
